title: Ordinary presheaf categories are locally presentable
statement: Fix a universe $\mathcal U$. Let $C$ be a $\mathcal U$-small ordinary category and $A$ an ordinary category locally presentable relative to $\mathcal U$, in the ordinary sense defined in [lem-coef-combinatorial-localization-presentability]. Assume that $A$ has pullbacks, meaning limits of all cospans $X\to Z\leftarrow Y$. Then the ordinary presheaf category $\operatorname{Fun}(C^{\mathrm{op}},A)$, whose objects are ordinary functors and whose morphisms are natural transformations, is locally presentable relative to $\mathcal U$. The category of its objects and its Hom sets are allowed to lie in larger universes.
